description: PERF regression net for the 'game freezes for several seconds after confirming weapons' report (Steam Deck). Clicking 'Fight!' dispatches BATCH_FIGHT_ACTIONS = ASSIGN_ATTACKS + CONFIRM_AND_RESOLVE_ATTACKS + ROLL_DICE in one synchronous call, and CONFIRM_AND_RESOLVE_ATTACKS used to run Mathhammer.simulate_combat() with 1000 Monte-Carlo trials PER TARGET inside it — each trial replaying the full RulesEngine. Measured on this exact path: 3583 ms of a 3605 ms action. The pre-roll estimate is now computed in closed form by Mathhammer.analytic_forecast(). This scenario drives the real player path (pile in, pick the Warboss, assign all weapons, click 'Fight!') and asserts (a) the wall-clock cost of the confirm click stays under 750 ms — it was ~3.6 s before, so the bound cannot be met by accident — and (b) the prediction line still renders in the Dice Log with a non-zero wounds estimate, i.e. the feature was made fast, not deleted. Setup-only privileges: CP zeroed to suppress stratagem prompts not under test.

steps.script:
var log_text = node.get_node("Main").fight_controller.dice_log_display.get_parsed_text()
return log_text.contains("Mathhammer Melee Predictions")
